sentences.en: ADAM: So, Michelle, shall we make a start on our presentation?
sentences.zh: ADAM: 那么，米歇尔，我们开始准备我们的演示文稿吧？

sentences.en: We haven't got that much time left
sentences.zh: 我们剩下的时间已经不多了。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: No, Adam
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 不行，亚当。

sentences.en: But at least we've done all the background reading
sentences.zh: 但至少我们已经完成了所有背景阅读。

sentences.en: I found it really interesting - I'd never even heard of the Laki eruption before this
sentences.zh: 我觉得这非常有趣——在这之前我甚至从未听说过拉基火山喷发。

sentences.en: ADAM: Me neither
sentences.zh: ADAM: 我也是。

sentences.en: I suppose 1783 is a long time ago
sentences.zh: 我想1783年确实是很早以前的事了。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: But it was a huge eruption and it had such devastating consequences
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 但那是一次规模巨大的火山喷发，造成了毁灭性的后果。

sentences.en: ADAM: know
sentences.zh: ADAM: 是的。

sentences.en: It was great there were so many primary sources to look at
sentences.zh: 很幸运当时有大量的一手资料可供查阅。

sentences.en: It really gives you a sense of how catastrophic the volcano was
sentences.zh: 这些资料确实让我们真切感受到这座火山灾难性的威力。

sentences.en: People were really trying to make sense of the science for the first time
sentences.zh: 人们当时正首次努力理解其中的科学原理。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: That's right
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 没错。

sentences.en: But what I found more significant was how it impacted directly and indirectly on political events. as well as having massive social and economic consequences
sentences.zh: 但我认为更值得关注的是它对政治事件产生的直接与间接影响，以及它所引发的巨大社会和经济后果。

sentences.en: ADAM: I know
sentences.zh: ADAM: 是的。

sentences.en: That should be the main focus of our presentation
sentences.zh: 这应当成为我们演示文稿的主要焦点。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: The observations made by people at the time were interesting, weren't they?
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 当时人们所做的观测很有意思，对吧？

sentences.en: mean, they all gave a pretty consistent account of what happened, even if they didn't always use the same terminology
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，尽管他们使用的术语并不总是一致，但他们对所发生事件的描述却相当一致。

sentences.en: ADAM: Yeah
sentences.zh: ADAM: 是的。

sentences.en: I was surprised there were so many weather stations established by that time - so, you know, you can see how the weather changed, often by the hour
sentences.zh: 令我惊讶的是，当时居然已设立了如此多的气象站——因此，你知道，你甚至能按小时观察到天气的变化。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: Right
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 没错。

sentences.en: Writers at the time talked about the Laki haze to describe the volcanic fog that spread across Europe
sentences.zh: 当时的作家用‘拉基霾’一词来描述蔓延至整个欧洲的火山雾。

sentences.en: They all realised that this wasn't the sort of fog they were used to - and of course this was in pre-industrial times - so they hadn't experienced sulphur-smelling fog before
sentences.zh: 他们都意识到，这种雾并非他们习以为常的那种——当然，那是在工业化之前的时代，因此他们此前从未经历过带有硫磺气味的雾。

sentences.en: ADAM: No, that's true
sentences.zh: ADAM: 是的，的确如此。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: Reports from the period blamed the haze for an increase in headaches
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 当时的报告将头痛加剧归咎于这种霾。

sentences.en: respiratory issues and asthma attacks
sentences.zh: 还有呼吸系统问题及哮喘发作。

sentences.en: And they all describe how it covered the sun and made it look a strange red colour
sentences.zh: 他们均描述了这种霾如何遮蔽太阳，并使其呈现出一种怪异的红色。

sentences.en: ADAM: Must have been very weird
sentences.zh: ADAM: 一定非常诡异。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: It's interesting that Benjamin Franklin wrote about the haze
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 本杰明·富兰克林曾撰文记述过这种霾，这一点很有意思。

sentences.en: Did you read that?
sentences.zh: 你读过那篇文章吗？

sentences.en: He was the American ambassador in Paris at the time
sentences.zh: 他当时是美国驻巴黎大使。

sentences.en: ADAM: Yeah
sentences.zh: ADAM: 是的。

sentences.en: At first no one realised that the haze was caused by the volcanic eruption in Iceland
sentences.zh: 起初，没人意识到这种霾是由冰岛的火山喷发所引起的。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: It was Benjamin Franklin who realised that before anvone else
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 是本杰明·富兰克林最先意识到这一点的，比任何人都早。

sentences.en: ADAM: He's often credited with that, apparently
sentences.zh: ADAM: 据说他通常因此而受到赞誉。

sentences.en: But a French naturalist beat him to it - I can't remember his name
sentences.zh: 但一位法国博物学家比他更早提出这一观点——我一时想不起他的名字了。

sentences.en: I'd have to look it up
sentences.zh: 我得去查一下。

sentences.en: Then other naturalists had the same idea - all independently of each other
sentences.zh: 随后其他博物学家也各自独立地提出了同样的观点。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: Oh right
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 哦，是这样。

sentences.en: We should talk about the immediate impact of the eruption, which was obviously enormous especially in Iceland, where SO many people died
sentences.zh: 我们应谈谈火山喷发带来的直接影响，其影响显然极为巨大，尤其是在冰岛，那里有太多人因此丧生。

sentences.en: ADAM: Mmm
sentences.zh: ADAM: 嗯。

sentences.en: You'd expect that - and the fact that the volcanic ash drifted so swiftly - but not that the effects would go on for so long
sentences.zh: 你本可以预料到这一点——火山灰如此迅速地飘散——但没想到其影响会持续如此之久。

sentences.en: Or that two years after the /26 eruption, strange weather events were being reported as far away as North
sentences.zh: 也没想到在/26年火山喷发两年后，远至北美洲的地区仍在报告异常天气事件。

sentences.en: /26 America and North Africa
sentences.zh: /26年北美洲和北非。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: No
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 不是。

sentences.en: I found all that hard to believe too
sentences.zh: 我也觉得所有这些都难以置信。

sentences.en: It must have been terrible - and there was It nothing anyone could do about it, even if they knew the ash cloud was coming in their direction
sentences.zh: 那一定非常可怕——而且人们对此束手无策，即便他们事先知道火山灰云正朝自己所在方向移动。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: We should run through some of the terrible consequences of the eruption experienced in different countries
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 我们应该梳理一下这次火山喷发在不同国家造成的种种严重后果。

sentences.en: There's quite a varied range
sentences.zh: 这些后果种类相当多样。

sentences.en: ADAM: Starting with Iceland, where the impact on farming was devastating
sentences.zh: ADAM: 先从冰岛说起，那里农业遭受了毁灭性打击。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: Mmm
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 嗯。

sentences.en: One of the most dramatic things there was the effect on livestock as they_ grazed in the fields
sentences.zh: 当地最触目惊心的现象之一，是牲畜在牧场放牧时受到的影响。

sentences.en: They were poisoned because they ate vegetation that had been contaminated with fluorine as a result of the volcanic fallout
sentences.zh: 它们因食用了受火山沉降物中氟化物污染的植被而中毒。

sentences.en: ADAM: That was horrible
sentences.zh: ADAM: 那太可怕了。

sentences.en: In Egypt, the bizarre weather patterns led to a severe drought and as a result the Nile didn't flood, which meant the crops all failed
sentences.zh: 在埃及，异常天气模式导致严重干旱，结果尼罗河未能如期泛滥，致使农作物全部歉收。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: It's so far from where the eruption happened and yet the famine there led to more people dying than any other country
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 这里距离火山喷发地点如此遥远，然而当地饥荒造成的死亡人数却超过其他任何国家。

sentences.en: It was worse than the plague
sentences.zh: 其严重程度甚至超过了瘟疫。

sentences.en: ADAM: OK
sentences.zh: ADAM: 好的。

sentences.en: Then in the UK the mortality rate went up a lot - presumably from respiratory illnesses
sentences.zh: 接着在英国，死亡率大幅上升——推测主要源于呼吸系统疾病。

sentences.en: According to one report it was about double the usual number and included an unusually high percentage of people under the age of 25
sentences.zh: 据一份报告称，死亡人数约为平常水平的两倍，且其中年龄不足25岁者所占比例异常之高。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: Mmm
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 嗯。

sentences.en: I think people will be surprised to hear that the weather in the USA was badly affected too
sentences.zh: 我想人们听到美国天气也受到严重影响时，一定会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: George Washington even makes a note in his diary that they were snowbound until March in Virginia
sentences.zh: 乔治·华盛顿甚至在日记中记下：弗吉尼亚州直到三月仍被大雪封困。

sentences.en: That was before he became president
sentences.zh: 那是在他成为总统之前。

sentences.en: ADAM: Yes, and there was ice floating down the Mississippi, which was unprecedented
sentences.zh: ADAM: 是的，密西西比河上还漂浮着浮冰，这在此前从未发生过。

sentences.en: MICHELLE: Astonishing, really
sentences.zh: MICHELLE: 确实令人震惊。

sentences.en: Anyway, what do you think
sentences.zh: 好了，你认为 ……
